# Microsoft 6502 BASIC source provenance

The historical `m6502.asm` source is third-party material from Microsoft's
published BASIC-M6502 repository:

https://github.com/microsoft/BASIC-M6502

The accompanying `LICENSE` applies to the Microsoft source in this directory.
It is separate from this project's root BSD 2-Clause license. Retain the
Microsoft copyright and permission notices with redistributed copies.

This assembly source is for reference and historical study. The emulator does
not compile or embed it. KIM-1 BASIC tape images, monitor ROMs, and external
conformance corpora are deliberately stored outside this source repository.
